import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int w = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        int n = 0;
        int[] a = new int[50];

        do {
            a[++n] = m % w;
            m /= w;
        } while (m > 0);

        boolean ok = true;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n;) {
            if (a[i] > 1) {
                a[i] += 1;
                if (a[i] == w) {
                    while (i <= n && a[i] >= w) {
                        a[i] = 0;
                        a[++i] += 1;
                    }
                } else {
                    ++i;
                }
                if (a[i - 1] > 1) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                ++i;
            }
        }
        System.out.print(ok ? "YES" : "NO");
        scanner.close();
    }
}
